statement: This model is an estimate. It was worked out from photographs, videos, Sony’s service manual and the Compact Cassette standard, and no part has yet been checked against a real unit. Every part carries a confirmation level, from 1 (modelled, not checked) to 6 (measured on two units by two people); today all are at level 1.
serialNotice: Serial number 12345 was chosen completely arbitrarily for this model and is not taken from any real unit.
exteriorNote: Go by the lettering. Serial ranges are approximate and differ by market.
